plan.title: Include opt-in policy evidence in shared completion decisions

criteria.description: Policy mode mapping rejects undefined modes and preserves existing configurations.
Status, Stop and pre-push share bootstrap/stale/new blocking and known/resolved/clean acceptance while preserving explicit shrink-only human approval.

limitations: mode_policy explicitly selects policy enforcement; no implicit execution or approval.
Known findings warn; resolved findings do not shrink the approved baseline without human approval, matching policy check.
Reports expose counts and digests without finding messages.
No push, release, installation or settings changes.
